title: Contents Allowance of a Home Oxygen Therapy Contents Month Paid in Full
content:
# Contents Allowance of a Contents Month Paid in Full — Home Oxygen Therapy

**Calculation.** The contents allowance of a Home Oxygen Therapy contents month after the payment cap that the coverage paid in full is the class's post-cap contents monthly fee multiplied by the coverage class's allowed percentage of the fee schedule, divided by 100, rounded once to the cent, half up.

## Inputs

| Input | Source |
|---|---|
| post-cap contents monthly fee | the product's contents schedule, for the class on the oxygen record |
| allowed percentage of the fee schedule | the coverage class of the coverage the oxygen record names |

## Order of the calculation

1. Take the class's post-cap contents monthly fee.
2. Multiply it by the allowed percentage of the fee schedule and divide by 100.
3. Round once, to the cent, half up. No figure is rounded before this point.

## Worked examples (hypothetical allowed percentages)

**A.** Liquid Oxygen System (E0439 + E0434), contents fee 79.12, allowed percentage 96: 79.12 multiplied by 96 and divided by 100 is 75.9552, rounded half up to 75.96.

**B.** Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431), contents fee 79.12, allowed percentage 100: 79.12.

**C.** High-Flow Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431), contents fee 79.12, allowed percentage 85: 67.252, rounded half up to 67.25.

## Points of judgement

**Where does the rounding happen?** Once, on the final contents allowance, to the cent and half up.

**Which coverage class supplies the allowed percentage?** The class of the coverage the oxygen record names.
